title: Move reply range
subtitle: Move one inclusive source-position range into an existing topic through the idempotent Forum owner.
warning: Positions are canonical owner positions, not row numbers. Sparse positions are valid; the owner verifies occupied endpoints, the 500-reply bound, parent edges, ACL equality, solution conflicts and counters.
retryHint: An exact retry keeps this identity. Editing source, target, either endpoint or reason rotates it.
failure: Reply range could not be moved.
